title: A non-prompt null ray cures its own singularity
summary: In AdS/CFT correlators, bulk cone singularities arise when two points that are timelike separated on the AdS boundary may be connected by a null geodesic through the bulk. We consider corrections to these correlators away from the $G_N\to 0$ limit arising from the backreaction of this null geodesic. A peculiar property of this geodesic is that it is not prompt, meaning that there exist points on it that are timelike separated. This implies that it may gravitationally affect itself.
